description: This file provides a class Neo4jWriter and related functions to write Article and Chunk entities, along with their relationships, into a Neo4j graph database. It manages schema creation, connection handling, and encapsulates write operations for articles and associated chunks with optional embeddings.

classes.name: Neo4jWriter
classes.description: A class that provides methods for connecting to Neo4j and writing Article and Chunk nodes, ensuring schema, and handling relationships and optional embeddings.

methods.name: str _hash_chunk_id(article_title: str, index: int, text: str)
methods.description: Computes a SHA-256 hash for a chunk ID based on article title, index, and a text sample to ensure uniqueness.

methods.name: __init__(self, uri: Optional[str] = None, user: Optional[str] = None, password: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes Neo4jWriter with optional URI, user, and password, defaulting to environment variables.

methods.name: Driver _get_driver(self)
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns a Neo4j driver instance, handling configuration and errors.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: Closes the Neo4j driver connection if open.

methods.name: _ensure_schema(self, session: Session)
methods.description: Creates necessary constraints and indexes in Neo4j for Article title uniqueness and Chunk ID indexing.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] write_article_with_chunks( self, title: str, url: str, chunks: Sequence[Dict[str, object]], embeddings: Optional[Sequence[Sequence[float]]] = None, store_embeddings: bool = True, )
methods.description: Main public method to write an article node with its associated chunks and relationships, optionally storing embeddings.
